findings: Corrected half-open ByLayer scan interval is[2,4), covering both stored bytes. The earlier[2,3) window could miss explicit byte+3 accesses.
Include typed constructors, destructor, assignment and equality operator exports alongside named methods. Wider memory accesses overlapping the complete word are retained.
Native unwind chains and fragments are retained. Non-unwind candidates are bounded by the next known entry/padding and checked for branch completeness; incomplete candidates remain discovery only.
Displacements and additional copy/equality accesses alone do not name remaining flag bits. No decoder alias, mask-domain closure or byte credit is assigned.
limitations: Static discovery only; no CAD execution. Export-scoped scan does not exhaust inlined/direct accesses in other functions or external modules. Folded code and overlapped accesses require receiver/dataflow proof before semantic binding. Existing field charges and part accounting unchanged.
